explanation: Many actors avoid saying the play's name inside a theatre, calling it 'the Scottish play' to dodge its supposed curse.

claims.text: In Macbeth, three witches chant 'Double, double toil and trouble'.
Hamlet, King Lear and The Tempest do not contain the witches' chant.
Theatre superstition holds that saying 'Macbeth' inside a theatre brings bad luck, so actors call it 'the Scottish play'.
